startupComparison.boundary: Fresh browser contexts, uncached local HTTP source, desktop headless shell at mobile viewport. Byte budgets are actual requested atlas file sizes and actual decoded RGBA geometry. Localhost startup timing is not a physical Android/network loading benchmark.

boundaries: Normal-input automated full routes accelerate fixed updates through actual app event handlers; no HP, positions, enemies, score or flags are modified during the two route runs.
Source HTTP checks use genuine origin-local storage. Exact offline HTML parser loading explicitly emulates storage.
Gamepad API objects are fixtures. CDP sends real browser touch events. Physical Android, Termux on Android, Logitech hardware, iPhone and desktop Safari are untested.
Playwright WebKit is a compatibility engine. Browser versions and binaries are recorded; no all-browser or all-device guarantee is made.
Stage/render/scenario fixtures and asset semantic assertions supplement, rather than substitute for, normal-input campaign runs.
No new music was synthesized. Existing supplied recordings, crossfades and optional-API fallbacks were tested.
knownLimitations: Public CI/HTTPS publication evidence is appended separately after release.
Cold localhost startup duration rose .432→.725 seconds in this headless sample despite ~46% lower startup atlas/decode budget; no measured wall-clock speedup is claimed.
